difficulty_reason: Characterize strongly cartesian morphisms (f, phi) : (Y, G) -> (X, F) of QCohstack as exactly those with phi inducing an isomorphism f*F -> G: there is a canonical f-map c : F -> f*F giving (f, c) : (Y, f*F) -> (X, F); claim (f, c) is strongly cartesian by the coproduct computation Mor_{QCohstack}((Z, H), (Y, f*F)) = coprod_g Mor_{QCoh(O_Z)}(g*f*F, H) = coprod_g Mor((f o g)*F, H) = Mor_{QCohstack}((Z, H), (X, F)) x_{Mor_S(Z, X)} Mor_S(Z, Y) using equation-morphisms-qcoh twice, which is the cartesian condition of categories-definition-cartesian-over-C; the 'if' direction follows because isomorphisms and compositions of strongly cartesian morphisms are strongly cartesian (categories-lemma-composition-cartesian); the 'only if' direction because a strongly cartesian lift of f with target (X, F) must be isomorphic to (f, c) by the uniqueness discussion after categories-definition-cartesian-over-C.
